# Wander & Tales

> A free, printable library of cooperative, adult-led story-adventure kits for kids.
> Read every story online in English, Spanish, Italian, and Portuguese, or download
> the printable PDFs. Nobody competes, nobody loses, and there are no wrong answers.

The games are played by a grown-up and one or more children together, with a single
die and household objects. There are seven worlds and twenty-one stories, each with a
Tale Book (two reading levels), an Atlas (map and pictures), and a World Book.

- Worlds and stories: https://wanderandtales.com/en/
- Create your own with Claude: https://github.com/agigante80/wander-and-tales#create-your-own-story
- Source and licence (CC BY-SA 4.0 content, MIT code): https://github.com/agigante80/wander-and-tales
